mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, c.content, c.images, c.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.comment_count AS commentCount, c.status, c.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM confession c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, c.content, c.images, c.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.comment_count AS commentCount, c.status, c.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM confession c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
